verdict.rationale: The only evidence about backups comes from a single community tier report: Supabase runs nightly pg_dump backups and the CEO said the team is moving toward PITR after an outage caused by backup-induced write contention (supabase-comm-5). This confirms some automated backup/PITR capability exists but reveals real operational risk, and there is no first-party documentation in this evidence pack describing backup schedules, retention, or PITR guarantees to corroborate it. missing for 10: first-party docs on automated backup policy, PITR SLAs/retention windows, and independent confirmation that the pg_dump-related outage issue has been resolved.
